successCriteria.description: BalanceService implements IBalanceService with all five methods (create, findById, findByEmployee, deduct, restore) whose signatures match the inline IBalanceService interface in src/modules/balance/balance.model.ts exactly (deduct/restore take no client param; findById/findByEmployee take an optional PoolClient last param).

balance.routes.ts exports an async balanceRoutes(fastify: FastifyInstance) function that instantiates PgLeaveBalanceRepository + UnitOfWork + BalanceService, validates inputs with Zod safeParse (400 VALIDATION_ERROR), enforces RBAC via requireRole(...UserRole) preHandlers, and returns { error, code } with 404 NOT_FOUND and 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.
src/modules/balance/index.ts barrel re-exports BalanceService and balanceRoutes in addition to the existing model/repository exports.

BalanceService.create generates id/createdAt/updatedAt and delegates to the repository without opening a transaction; deduct/restore wrap in uow.withTransaction when no client is supplied and reuse a supplied client otherwise.

constraints: The service must not import a pool, a pg client, or any module-level db helper; it receives IUnitOfWork via constructor injection and delegates all DB access to the repository (GP-001).
The balance service must not reference the leave module or the notification module (sibling sub-phases / later phase).
No test files may be created in this sub-phase (tests belong to Phase 3c).
Do not introduce a stored pendingDays field on LeaveBalance; availableDays is derived only via computeAvailableDays and never persisted.
The route file must not be wired into app.ts in this sub-phase; only the route file + barrel export are in scope.
outOfScope: Notification service + routes (src/modules/notification/notification.service.ts, notification.routes.ts, index.ts) — sibling sub-phase 3b.
Unit/integration tests for balance and notification services (tests/unit/modules/balance/balance.service.spec.ts, tests/unit/modules/notification/notification.service.spec.ts) — sibling sub-phase 3c.
The leave orchestration module (leave.model/repository/service/routes) and any reference to it from the balance service.

entityInvariants.invariant: availableDays is always derived (computeAvailableDays(totalEntitlement, usedDays, pendingDays)) and never stored; it may go negative and must not be clamped.

The three stored counters (totalEntitlement, usedDays, remainingDays) are non-negative; a deduct/restore transition that would take a counter below zero throws NegativeBalanceCounterError (never clamps).

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Invalid input (negative counters) surfaces as NegativeBalanceCounterError; route maps to 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.
Taking remainingDays below zero throws NegativeBalanceCounterError; route maps to 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.
Taking usedDays below zero throws NegativeBalanceCounterError; route maps to 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.
Missing balance returns null; route maps to 404 NOT_FOUND.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: BalanceService must implement the inline IBalanceService interface exactly as declared (method names, parameter order, optional PoolClient last param on findById/findByEmployee, no client param on deduct/restore).

The service must delegate to PgLeaveBalanceRepository methods (create/findById/findByEmployee/deduct/restore) and rely on its existing non-negative guards and NegativeBalanceCounterError rather than re-implementing them.

Transaction ownership must follow the IUnitOfWork.withTransaction contract: service owns the boundary, data-access opens it, participating methods take optional client last param and fall back to uow.withTransaction.
Route file must follow the existing employee/policy route pattern: Zod safeParse, requireRole preHandlers, { error, code } error shape with VALIDATION_ERROR/NOT_FOUND/INTERNAL_ERROR codes.
RBAC must use the requireRole guard and UserRole enum, never inline role checks.

integrationPoints.why: Service delegates all persistence and counter-guard enforcement to this repository.
Service injects IUnitOfWork to own transaction boundaries for deduct/restore.
Route-level RBAC guard for balance endpoints.
Role enum used by requireRole preHandlers in balance routes.
